claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is policy-compliant and evidentially supported despite the insurance claims triage segment missing target, because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and governance guidance allows deployment with documented limitations and monitoring.
decision_criteria: If admissible evidence shows the material limitation was disclosed before launch, the verdict could improve.
If admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covered the named launch use case before launch, the verdict could improve.
If the evaluation gap is resolved so the material limitation no longer exists, the verdict could improve.
Without one of those conditions, certification of a named launch use case with an unresolved material limitation remains noncompliant under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: Final approved disclosure artifact showing the insurance claims triage limitation was disclosed for launch.
Approved risk acceptance explicitly covering the 1.5-point gap for the named carrier pilot commitments, if disclosure will not occur before launch.
Resolution of the open legal ticket stating whether disclosure is required and the final approved disposition.
Launch decision record showing certification was conditioned on completed disclosure or approved risk acceptance before release.
specific_concerns: The policy makes the weakness material because the affected segment is a named launch use case and is named in two carrier pilot commitments.
The release policy requires disclosure of material limitations before launch unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.
No admissible evidence shows that the limitation has been disclosed in the model card or otherwise before launch.
No admissible evidence shows an approved risk acceptance covering this gap.
Legal review on required disclosure is still open, which leaves a required policy predicate unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one incidents do not satisfy the separate disclosure requirement for a material limitation.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently compliant on the existing record.
That documentation and monitoring are already in place rather than merely recommended.
That public governance guidance is sufficient to override or satisfy the release policy's specific disclosure/approval requirement.
